chapterInfo.content:
2
Rut di Boas afuo mu mpɛpɛ
1Na Naomi nyaa ne kunu busuani bi a ɔyɛ ɔbarima kunini a ɔfiri Elimelek abusua mu a ne din de Boas. 2Na Rut, Moabni baa no ka kyerɛɛ Naomi sɛ: Ma menkɔ mfuo mu menkɔdi mmɛtem no mpɛpɛ deɛ mɛnya n’anim animuonyam akyi. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Me ba, kɔ ɛ! 3Na ɔkɔ kɔdii mpɛpɛ afuo mu wɔ atwafoɔ no akyi. Na ɔkɔfirii afuo bi a ɛyɛ Boas a ɔfiri Elimelek abusua mu no deɛ mu. 4Na hwɛ, Boas firi Betlehem bae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ atwafoɔ no sɛ: AWURADE nni mo akyi! Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: AWURADE nhyira wo. 5Ɛnna Boas ka kyerɛɛ n’akoa a ɔgyina atwafoɔ no akyire sɛ: Hwan ababaa nie? 6Na akoa a wɔde no agyina ayutwafoɔ no akyire no kaa sɛ: Ɛyɛ Moabni ababaa a ɔne Naomi sane firii Moab asase so baeɛ no. 7Ɔbɛkaa sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma menni ayutwafoɔ no akyi menni mpɛpɛ mentase afiafi no ntam. Na ɔbae, na ɔkura mu ara de firi anɔpa de abɛduru sɛsɛɛ a ɔnhomee kakraa bi mpo.
8Ɛnna Boas ka kyerɛɛ Rut sɛ: Me ba, tie, nkɔ afuo biara mu nkɔdi mpɛpɛ, nso mfiri ha, na fa wo ho bɔ me mmaawa yi ho. 9Ma w’ani mmra afuo no fa a wɔtwa hɔ, na di wɔn akyi. Hwɛ, mahyɛ mmeranteɛ no sɛ wɔnnha wo. Na sɛ sukɔm de wo a, kɔ nnoɔma no ho kɔnom deɛ mmeranteɛ no asa no bi. 10Ɛnna ɔde n’anim butuiɛ, na ɔkotoo fam na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na manya w’anim adom, na w’ani ku me a meyɛ ɔnanani ho yi? 11#Rut 1.16-17 Na Boas buaa no sɛ: Deɛ wo kunu wuo akyi woyɛɛ w’ase no nyinaa, wɔatu aseɛ aka akyerɛ me; sɛdeɛ wogyaa w’agya ne wo na ne asase a wɔwoo wo wɔ soɔ, na wonam baa ɔman a wonni wɔn da yi nkyɛn no. 12AWURADE nhyɛ wo wo nneyɛɛ ananmu na nya akatua mu firi AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn a woaba ne ntaban ase abɛdan no no nsam. 13Na ɔkaa sɛ: Me wura, ma me nkɔ so ara nya w’anim adom, ɛfiri sɛ, woakyekyere me werɛ, na woaka w’abaawa asomdwoeɛsɛm, nso mente sɛ wo mmaawa yi mu biara mpo.
14Na ɛduruu adidiberɛ no, Boas ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Bra ha bɛdi aduane no bi, na fa wo buprɛko bɔ nsa kekakeka no mu. Na ɔbɛtenaa ayutwafoɔ no nkyɛn. Na ɔmaa no nkyeweɛ no bi, na ɔwe mee maa ebi kae. 15Na ɔsɔree sɛ ɔrekɔdi mpɛpɛ no, Boas hyɛɛ ne mmeranteɛ no sɛ: Momma no nni afiafi no nso ntam mpɛpɛ, na mommpoopoo no. 16#Lew 19.9 Na monyiyi afiafi no mu deɛ no bi nnyae mu ngu fam mma no, na ɔnni mpɛpɛ; na monnyeyɛ no.
17Ɛnna ɔdii afuo no mu mpɛpɛ de kɔduruu anwummerɛ, na ɔporee mpɛpɛ a ɔdiiɛ no, na ɛyɛɛ bɛyɛ atokoɔ efa baako.
18Na ɔsoa baa kuro no mu; na n’ase hunuu deɛ ɔtaseeɛ no; na ɔyii deɛ ɔdi meeɛ na ɛkaeɛ no maa no. 19Ɛnna n’ase ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛhe na wokɔdii mpɛpɛ nnɛ, na ɛhe na wokɔyɛɛ adwuma yi? Nhyira nka deɛ n’ani kuu wo ho no. Na ɔkyerɛɛ n’ase onii ko a ɔkɔyɛɛ ne nkyɛn adwuma no sɛ: Ɔbarima a mekɔyɛɛ ne nkyɛn adwuma nnɛ no din de Boas. 20Na Naomi ka kyerɛɛ n’ase no sɛ: Nhyira nka no AWURADE a ɔnnyaee ateasefoɔ ne awufoɔ adɔeɛyɛ no anim. Na Naomi ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɔbarima no bɛn yɛn, ɔyɛ yɛn bogya. 21Na Moabni Rut kaa sɛ: Nso ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Mmeranteɛ a mewɔ yi ho na bata kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛwie deɛ mewɔ nyinaa twa. 22Na Naomi ka kyerɛɛ n’ase Rut sɛ: Me ba, ɛyɛ sɛ wo ne ne mmaawa no bɛkorɔ, na wɔanhu wo, afu foforɔ bi mu. 23Na ɔbataa Boas mmaawa no ho dii mpɛpɛ de kɔsii sɛ wɔwiee atokoɔ ne ayuo no twa. Na ɔtenaa n’ase no nkyɛn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
